title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: classes, packing groups and equipment by category
content:
## What this card covers
For the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product of Aurelia Hanse Line, this card lists for each of the six acceptance categories the IMDG classes or divisions it accepts, the packing groups it accepts, whether the goods must be packed as IMDG limited quantities, and the equipment types the goods may be packed in.

## Category parameters
| Category (rank) | Classes or divisions accepted | Packing groups accepted | Must be packed as limited quantities | Equipment types allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity (1) | 2.2, 3, 4.1, 5.1, 6.1, 8, 9 | II, III | Yes | 20DV, 40DV, 40HC, 45HC |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard (2) | 9 | II, III, none | No | 20DV, 40DV, 40HC, 20RF, 40RH |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives (3) | 3, 4.1, 8 | I, II, III | No | 20DV, 40DV, 40HC, 20TK |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers (4) | 5.1, 5.2, 6.1 | I, II, III | No | 20DV, 40DV, 20TK |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases (5) | 2.1, 2.2, 2.3 | none | No | 20DV, 40DV |
| AHL DG Special Approval (6) | 1.4S, 4.2, 4.3, 7 | I, II, III, none | No | 20DV |

"none" in the packing-group column stands for goods declared with no packing group. The equipment types are those recorded on the booking that carries the goods.

## Reading the table by column
- **Classes**: a class or division appears on a category's list or it does not; the lists of AHL DG Limited Quantity and of the full-load categories overlap (for example class 3 is on both the Limited Quantity list and the Flammables and Corrosives list).
- **Packing group I** is on the lists of AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives, AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers and AHL DG Special Approval only.
- **Limited quantities** are a packing requirement of AHL DG Limited Quantity alone.
- **Reefer equipment** (20RF, 40RH) appears only for AHL DG Class 9 Standard; the tank type 20TK appears only for AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives and AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers; 45HC appears only for AHL DG Limited Quantity.

## Points of judgement (read from the table)
- *Is division 2.2 listed for more than one category?* Yes: AHL DG Limited Quantity and AHL DG Compressed Gases both list it, and only the first carries the limited-quantity packing requirement.
- *Does any category list class 9 with packing group I?* No. AHL DG Limited Quantity lists class 9 with groups II and III, and AHL DG Class 9 Standard lists groups II, III and none.
- *Which categories list a 40HC?* AHL DG Limited Quantity, AHL DG Class 9 Standard and AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives.
